descriptions.description: Lysimachia minima (chaffweed) is a 1-4 inch (2–10 cm) perennial herb in the primula family (Primulaceae). A cosmopolitan species, this small plant is native widely across North America and Eurasia.Flora of North America It can be found growing in moist soils and seasonal pools.
